shareDesktopPerceivedNarrowCard.followUp: If users still perceive desktop Share as mobile-like, test deliberate full-workbench composition rather than raw two-column existence.

nextDocumentsAcceptance: Default Documents cockpit remains bounded and keeps core 3 document affordance.
After selecting risk-assessment edit/detail, the first meaningful editable content or field summary intersects the visible viewport or bounded pane immediately.
Selected editor/detail has sticky local context and no toolbar or pane-edge overlap.
Long raw textarea/document body is explicitly secondary drilldown.
WorkpackEditor export and canonical contracts remain unchanged.
shareFollowUpAcceptance: Desktop generated/current Share should read as a deliberate full-workbench composition, not only two raw columns.
Recipient/channel/provenance/action and preview regions should have meaningful x ranges and no horizontal overflow.
Long messages, provider results, language variants, logs, and raw metadata remain bounded drilldown.
Provider live dispatch remains approval-gated and unclaimed.
structuralConclusion: Page split helps orientation but is insufficient. The launch UX contract is step split plus first-viewport cockpit plus bounded drilldown/detail with persistent local context.
